_desc: Single table of thresholds and memory estimates for the mgp device manager. Read by py/device.py (Python) and src/device.mjs (Node, mgp doctor). Unit GB (1 GB = 1024^3 bytes). 'Measured' numbers come from an RTX 500 Ada 4 GB laptop, Core Ultra 7 165H, 05-11-2026.

chatterbox._desc: Chatterbox Multilingual fp32 (t3 + s3gen + voice encoder). Measured 05-11-2026 (RTX 500 Ada 4 GB): reserved peak 3.54 GB while speaking; 3.2 GB + margin 0.5 = needs 3.7 GB free, which just fits a free 4 GB card (3.8 GB). When the VRAM is in use by another app, CPU; OOM midway -> retried on the CPU.

openvoice._desc: OpenVoice V2 ToneColorConverter only (Chatterbox counted separately).

whisper-small._desc: faster-whisper small; GPU float16, CPU int8.

flux2-klein-4b-gguf._desc: mgp image local (py/image_engine.py). FLUX.2 klein 4B: GGUF Q4_K_M transformer 2.6 GB + VAE 0.17 GB on the GPU; the Qwen3-4B text encoder runs first on the CPU and is then dropped. Measured 05-11-2026: text encoder phase bf16 RSS peak 11.0 GB (load 63 s + encode 34 s; fp32 18.4 GB, encode 9 s). ram_gb = the peak of that phase.

flux-schnell._desc: Estimate (not measured yet) for FLUX.1 schnell GGUF in mgp image. Diffusers with enable_model_cpu_offload / sequential offload.

voice._desc: RTF = compute seconds per audio second. The default numbers are used while this machine has no measurement in its cache (ukur.json).

image._desc: Measured 05-11-2026 with FLUX.2 klein 4B GGUF Q4_K_M (mgp image local): a 4 GB GPU is enough (VRAM peak 3.5-3.8 GB without references), 11 GB free RAM for the text encoder phase.

render._desc: One worker = one headless Chrome tab + one ffmpeg.
